activities.name: Find the customer
activities.description: Search the customer by name or customer number and select the account.

activities.name: Create the new customer
activities.description: When the search finds no account, create the customer with its name, e-mail, phone and country.

activities.name: Enter the order
activities.description: Choose the product, type the quantity and the delivery date, choose the priority and save the order.

activities.name: Print the order confirmation
activities.description: Print the confirmation for a customer who asks for one on paper.

activities.name: Add the order to the tracking sheet
activities.description: Type the order number, customer, item, quantity and unit price as a new row of the order tracking sheet and save it.

activities.name: Look up the SAP material
activities.description: Find the item's SAP material number in the material mapping file.
